data.one_liner: A linear and radial gauge package for Flutter to display progress and measurements.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable linear and radial gauges with support for pointers, value bars, custom curves, ranges, and user interactivity.
use_when: You need to display machinery information, progress, or metrics using linear or radial gauges.
You want interactive gauges that respond to drag gestures on pointers.
avoid_when: You need complex data visualization charts like line, bar, or pie charts.
You are looking for non-gauge UI components.
strengths: Supports both linear and radial gauges with multiple customization options.
Built-in animations for pointers, value bars, and overall visibility.
Interactive pointers that respond to user drag.
weaknesses: Limited shape pointer support in radial gauges (currently only circle shape is supported).

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_gauges
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick Syncfusion for a more mature, feature-rich set of gauge widgets backed by a commercial vendor.
